$comment: The one resolved-versions surface (ADR-63). Everything a bootstrap resolves is named here: host binaries (x86-64 Linux only, fable/design 18) with sha256 pins, and control-plane Helm chart versions. cli/src/lib.ts and infra/src/control-flow/config.ts import this file; cli/tests/versions.test.ts fails on any second literal copy of a pin. The k3s installer is vendored at infra/scripts/server/vendor/k3s-install.sh and verified against k3sInstallerSha256 before it runs; the k3s binary itself is checksum-verified by that installer.

runtimes.$comment: Agent runtimes the platform deploys (ADR-149). eve.version is the npm `eve` release baked into the eve-runtime image AND the image tag; harness/eve/image/build.sh and harness/eve/charts/eve-agent read it, and the boot script refuses a project whose resolved eve differs from it.

loki.$comment: Control-plane log aggregation (#661, ADR 0165). These pin the images control-plane/loki/chart deploys; the chart's values.yaml defaults must equal them (asserted by cli/tests/versions.test.ts).

wiki.$comment: The in-cluster manual (#664, ADR 0167). control-plane/wiki/image/build.sh builds+tags this from the repo root (the site is baked at the platform revision, /version self-reports); the chart's values.yaml default must equal it (cli/tests/versions.test.ts).

nexus.$comment: The Nexus UI host image (#845): python + fastapi + uvicorn + git. control-plane/nexus/image/build.sh builds+tags this; the chart's values.yaml default must equal it (cli/tests/versions.test.ts). `hg up` builds it locally and imports it into k3d, so the local loop no longer needs the legacy agent image.
